elements.label: Cirrus website card expanding to full frame

sfx_review.label: unsure
sfx_review.note: Same burst as in e006, ~490 ms before this expansion starts; short noisy upper-mid band, no clear whoosh contour. Too early to be synced to this move.

pattern.description: The rounded browser card of the Cirrus site scales up from inset-on-gradient to fill the whole frame, its rounded corners and the purple backdrop leaving the edges; the page contents scale with it.
pattern.why_premium: A fast-start, soft-landing expand turns a framed 'product shot' into an immersive full-screen demo without a cut, keeping spatial continuity.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to(browserCard, {scale: 1.07, borderRadius: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out', transformOrigin: '50% 50%'}); background gradient stays fixed; contents are children, no stagger.
build_hint.remotion: spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120, mass: 1}}) (no overshoot) mapped to scale 1 -> 1.07 and borderRadius 24 -> 0 on the card wrapper.

notes: camera.move is none but scale is 1.066 with the backdrop disappearing at the edges; treated as the card scaling to full-bleed rather than a camera move. Continues the slow scale from e006.
